turns.speaker: unknown
turns.text: SunPeak Solar / Invoca | renewal | Mon, Oct 19, 2026

turns.speaker: [PERSON_4]
turns.text: Hey everyone, thanks for making time. I know it's a busy Monday. [PERSON_1], [PERSON_2], [PERSON_3], good to see you all.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Thanks [PERSON_4]. [PERSON_5], good to finally meet you.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_5]
turns.text: Same here, [PERSON_1]. I've heard a lot about SunPeak from [PERSON_4].

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: We've got about forty minutes before my next thing, so let's get into it.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_4]
turns.text: Sounds good. I figured we'd start with where you all are coming from, and then talk about what the renewal looks like.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: I'll just start, then. We're six weeks out, and I've got a budget number I need to hit for next year. Right now the Invoca line is the second biggest item in my marketing tech stack.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_5]
turns.text: What's the number you're working with?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: We're at two sixty-eight annually. We went from a hundred and ninety to two sixty-eight over two years, and the AI Voice Agent piece is most of that. I need that number to come down.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_5]
turns.text: Okay. Can I ask what you're targeting?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: I'd like to see something in the low two hundreds. Call it two fifteen, two twenty.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_4]
turns.text: That's a pretty significant step down from where we are. Can I ask what's driving the target? Is it overall budget pressure, or is it specific to what you're getting from us?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Mostly budget. The CFO gave every department a percentage cut and I have to find it somewhere.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: From my side, the product is working. My team uses it every day. I'm not looking to change tools.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_5]
turns.text: That's helpful to hear, [PERSON_2]. [PERSON_1], when you say the AI Voice Agent is most of the increase, is the concern the per minute cost or the seat count?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Both. We're at seventy seats, and the voice minutes went up more than we projected. Part of that is we're just getting more calls.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: More calls is a good problem, but it does mean the bill scales with volume, which is not something I can easily forecast.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: The integrations aren't the issue. It's the total spend.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: One thing I do want to put on the table. CallRail told us they can send conversions to Google the same day, and their quote was a lot lower.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_5]
turns.text: Okay. When did you talk to them?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: A couple weeks ago. I took the meeting because they kept calling. I'm not saying we're switching, but I'd be lying if I said the number didn't get my attention.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: [PERSON_3], you didn't mention that to me.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: It was exploratory. I didn't want to make it a thing.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_4]
turns.text: I'd rather know than not know, so I appreciate you saying it. Can I ask what the quote covered? Same seat count, same voice volume?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: Roughly. Their voice offering is newer, so I'd want to pilot it before I believed it.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_5]
turns.text: That's fair. I won't pretend I can match a number I haven't seen. What I can do is go back and look at what we can do on the structure, particularly the seat and minute mix.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: I'm not going to sign a renewal at this number. We'll run an RFP if we have to.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_5]
turns.text: Understood. Nobody here wants to put you through an RFP, [PERSON_1]. Give me until Thursday and let me come back with something real.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Thursday works. But I want to be clear that two sixty-eight is not a starting point for a small discount.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: For what it's worth, I don't want to go through an RFP either. My reps would lose weeks.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_4]
turns.text: [PERSON_2], how's the bilingual side holding up? I know that was a focus when we set things up.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: It's fine. The Spanish language calls get classified correctly and the summaries are usable. No issues.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_4]
turns.text: Good. And the quality side, anything you want me to look at?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: Nothing pressing. We're getting what we need out of it.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_5]
turns.text: [PERSON_1], one more question. Is the constraint purely the annual number, or is there flexibility if we move some of it to a different line, say a one-time credit applied to the first quarter?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: It's an annual number. How you get there is your problem, not mine.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_5]
turns.text: That's a clear answer. I'll take it.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_4]
turns.text: One thing I can do in the meantime is pull the usage report so we're all looking at the same minute counts. There may be some volume on the voice agent that you're paying for that you didn't plan for.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: That would help. If the overage is real, I want to see it.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: Send it to me too. I'll compare it against what I'm seeing in the ad platforms.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_5]
turns.text: [PERSON_1], can I ask who else needs to be in the room on Thursday? Is the CFO involved?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Not on the call, but I have to be able to take the number to her.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_5]
turns.text: Then let's make sure whatever I bring is something you can take upstairs without reworking it.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: [PERSON_1], do you want me on Thursday?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Yes, please. And [PERSON_3], if he can make it.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: I can make it.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_4]
turns.text: I'll send a calendar hold for Thursday at the same time and get the usage report over before then.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_5]
turns.text: I'll have a proposal for you by Wednesday night so you have time to look at it before we talk.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Wednesday night is fine. I'll look at it Thursday morning.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_4]
turns.text: Anything else before we get off? [PERSON_2], [PERSON_3]?

turns.speaker: [PERSON_2]
turns.text: I'm good. Thanks [PERSON_4].

turns.speaker: [PERSON_3]
turns.text: Nothing from me.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_1]
turns.text: Thursday, then. Thanks everyone.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_5]
turns.text: Thanks [PERSON_1]. Talk Thursday.

turns.speaker: [PERSON_4]
turns.text: Thanks all. I'll send the hold in a few minutes.
